repository.name: agid-postal-iq
repository.purpose: Iraq postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU 03/2005 sheet and the 2004 Iraqi Post and Ministry of Communications scheme announcement document five digits with region, governorate or province, delivery-type and post-office semantics. Production assignment requires an exact current Iraq Post artifact with postal object type, authority, jurisdiction, validity, retrieval time, schema and digest pinned. The dated UPU sheet, historical announcement, operator app, ArcGIS StoryMap, NOGP, IGP, COSIT, OSM, coordinate or model does not create a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A five-digit code is opaque and may identify a post office, delivery type, P.O. Box, business holdout, point or other non-area object. Never generate official geometry from digits, an office point, administrative containment or proximity. Official postal geometry requires an exact Iraq Post artifact explicitly relating the code to geometry and pinning authority, jurisdiction, validity, CRS, topology, licence and digest. Administrative, statistical, road, OSM, Voronoi, interpolation and model surfaces remain independent candidate or derived evidence.
postal_system.transition_rule: A public 2025 ArcGIS StoryMap describes converting five-digit office numbers to postal zones and adding a three-character road or street sector. ArcGIS item metadata names owner fatima_atlasgis and provides no licence or access-information statement. Until Iraq Post authorship, deployment status, exact syntax, coverage, version and reuse rights are independently pinned, the zone-sector value remains a separate unverified migration candidate and is rejected by the current five-digit postcode parser.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organisation, house, street, quarter or mahalla, alley, district, locality, governorate, P.O. Box, postcode, coordinates and delivery objects remain typed, sourced, jurisdiction-aware and validity-aware. App input or a map coordinate does not establish a public recipient, resident, owner, occupant, legal unit, entrance, exact civic-address identity, building relation or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building geometry with purpose, authority, jurisdiction, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. Postcode, app location, IGP search, NOGP catalog, COSIT boundary, road, parcel or OSM footprint is not an automatic address-building relation.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Postal assignments, official or derived surfaces, address points and buildings may link to AGID cells through explicit versioned crosswalks without relabelling a postcode, sector candidate, address, governorate, district, parcel, building or territory as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is Iraq Post geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The public Iraq Post service pages, UPU sheet and historical announcement do not grant bulk assignment, geometry or redistribution rights. The 2025 ArcGIS item has no licence or access-information statement. NOGP policy aims to enable reuse and redistribution of exact public government resources subject to data-protection, privacy and information-security rules, but catalog presence does not cover IGP, COSIT or postal artifacts automatically. Pin every exact resource, publisher, policy version, override and digest. ODbL data remains separate.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Iraq Post privacy policy updated 2025-05-25 identifies names, email, phone and permitted location as personal data. Recipients, senders, accounts, identity numbers, postcode or address queries, home and alley numbers, private coordinates, P.O. Box holders, identities, residents, owners, occupants, credentials and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication approval are required.
postal_system.territorial_rule: Country code IQ selects a runtime and source contract; it is not a sovereignty, jurisdiction, administrative-boundary or coverage assertion. Federal, governorate, Kurdistan Region, local and other source authority, jurisdiction, language, validity and licence must be explicit. No single postal, NOGP, IGP, COSIT, administrative or community source is presumed to cover every area or settle boundary status.

stages.definition: Metadata-only source contract and synthetic runtime behavior; no real assignment, civic-address or geometry release.

A current rights-cleared Iraq Post assignment release, complete for its explicitly declared source and jurisdiction scope, preserves five-digit strings, postal-object and delivery types, validity and transition status; reproducible conversion and full-data validation feed immutable digest-pinned published data verified through the AGID loader/API. Any geometry or civic-address/building relation has independent authority, rights, temporal scope and lineage; no polygon, universal coverage or territorial authority is presumed.
